result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals, providing a basic level of safety for residential foot traffic. However, the wide curb radius and lack of physical traffic calming measures like bulb-outs may encourage higher vehicle speeds during turns.

hazards.name: Wide Corner Radius
hazards.description: The large radius of the curb at the intersection allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Vegetation Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: The large, dense bush on the corner may obscure smaller pedestrians, such as children, from the view of drivers approaching the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the corner

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to narrow the roadway at the crossing, reducing pedestrian exposure distance and slowing turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove the large bush at the corner to ensure clear sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility crosswalk markings and traffic signals adjacent to an institutional building. However, the wide roadway creates a long unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians without a refuge island or visible pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time in the conflict zone without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, signalized intersection with multiple travel lanes and long pedestrian crossing distances. While marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals are present on at least one leg, the overall environment prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian comfort and safety.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway on the right side.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows for high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised islands in the center of the wide roadway to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at corners to shorten crossing distances and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized residential intersection with sidewalks and marked crosswalks. However, the crosswalk markings are faded and the pavement within the crossing area is degraded, potentially creating trip hazards and reducing visibility.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse lines of the crosswalk are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and potholes in the asphalt within the crosswalk area present a trip hazard for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection within the crosswalk area

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with high-visibility continental or ladder-style markings to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian countdown signals to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection to eliminate trip hazards and provide a smooth walking surface.
